newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Cbank sets 3-day sell/buy tender for Finmin.
newsitem.headline: Czech Cbank sets 3-day sell/buy tender for Finmin.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Tuesday set a three-day "sell and buy" tender for the Finance Ministry with a maximum rate of of 18.5 percent.
The CNB set the deadline for bids in the operation for 0800 GMT and said two bids would be accepted at a minimum of 100 million crowns each.
The central bank performed a similar operation for the Finance Ministry on June 16.
The CNB also set a one week "sell and buy" tender on June 17 which attracted an average yield of 28.98 percent.

The operations, on which neither the CNB nor the Finance Ministry have commented, are believed to be performed with the aim of providing short term financing for the Finance Ministry which has been short of cash to pay wages.
